name: Channel Requests
description: Lets non-admins request new channels for admin approval, with configurable naming rules and automatic member add.

settings_schema.header:
## Channel Requests

Lets non-admins **request** channels instead of creating them directly. Requests are posted to the approval channel below (or, if none is set, sent by direct message to every System Admin); System Admins (and optionally Team Admins) can approve or deny.

Pick the approval team + channel via the dropdowns, then configure domain prefixes so channels follow your naming convention automatically. Requesters see a form with a prefix picker + tab-complete member + Channel Admin selectors.

[View the documentation](/plugins/com.mattermostfederal.channel-requests/public/help/help.html)

settings.help_text: Dropdown of teams you're a member of. Pick the team containing your approval channel. Saved as the team ID, so renaming the team doesn't change where requests go.

Dropdown of channels in the selected team. Pick the channel where new channel requests get posted for approval. Saved as the channel ID. If it isn't set, or the channel is missing or archived, requests are sent by direct message to every System Admin instead.

Structured editor: define allowed channel prefixes (team-, project-, etc.) with descriptions and suffix rules. Requesters pick from a dropdown; the resulting channel URL is prefix+suffix. Includes preset packs for common org shapes and a live preview.

When enabled, Team Admins of the approval team can approve or deny channel-creation requests in addition to System Admins. Channel Admin requests are always reviewed by System Admins and the Team Admins of the channel's own team, whatever this is set to. Nobody but a System Admin can approve their own request.

Tab-complete picker: pick users whose channel requests bypass approval and create the channel immediately. Useful for delegated managers. Saved as user IDs, so renaming an account doesn't change who is on the list.
When set, every approve/deny action logs a message to this channel. Useful for compliance. It must be a private channel the bot can post in.
How many requests of each kind (new channel, Channel Admin) one user can have waiting for review, up to 1000. 0 means no limit.
Pending requests older than this can no longer be approved, and stop counting toward the per-user limit. At most 3650. 0 means requests never expire. Applies to existing requests too.

When true, the Mattermost Agents plugin can list prefixes and file channel and Channel Admin requests on a user's behalf, under the same rules as the slash command. Requests from System Admins and auto-approve users take effect at once. Agents can never approve or deny. Takes effect on save; per-tool access is managed in Agents' System Console.

Do not enable in production. When true, System Admins can run /channel-request exercise populate, teardown and status to seed marked EXERCISE data into a team: persona accounts nobody can sign in as, a channel, and pending requests on the approval cards. Approving a seeded request creates a real channel marked EXERCISE. Teardown closes the requests, archives the channels and deactivates the personas.

Leave blank to use the built-in fictional scenario. Paste a scenario here to seed your own personas, channels and requests instead. It is stored only in this server's configuration. The format is described in the plugin documentation.
